summary: This Form 6-K filed by NICE Ltd. reports the results of a 2026 Special General Meeting, stating shareholders approved all proposals voted on at the meeting, as described in prior proxy materials. There is no transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist activity, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change; it is a routine corporate governance filing. No deal terms are disclosed because no transaction is involved.
